rules.eligibility: Rank assessments with any available hazard or exposure evidence. Missing components contribute zero to sums and do not exclude partial assessments.
rules.rank: One plus the number of eligible scores strictly greater than this score.
rules.ties: Exact numeric equality before display rounding; equal scores share competition rank.
rules.display: Descending score, then full InChIKey ascending; identifiers are not scientific tie-breakers.
rules.top_n: Include every record tied with the Nth eligible record; return all eligible records when N exceeds the pool.
rules.unranked: Null rank and null Top-N selection; retain source context and missingness reasons.
rules.tier: Retain Stage 7A tiers; tiers do not sort or break ties.
rules.historical: Default: reconstruct historical score order by exact descending score then full InChIKey, labelling it portable rather than frozen replay. Optional strict mode reproduces legacy pandas quicksort and enforces the frozen Top-100 order fingerprint. Neither mode changes current analysis ranks or inclusive Top-N.

historical.comparison_scope: Identity order and the overlapping migrated score/status/tier fields; additional legacy annotations are not reconstructed.
